stem: Two rooms use the same irrigation clock schedule, but their root-zone dryback trends differ. Which explanation is most defensible?
choices: Different environment, crop size, substrate, container or sensor context may be changing demand or measured response
Clock time guarantees identical root-zone behavior
The drier room always needs more fertilizer
Dryback is independent of plant demand
rationale: Root-zone response depends on multiple system variables. A shared clock schedule does not guarantee equal water demand or dryback.
